observation: owner reports the panel went black after about ten minutes of the first persistent-data boot
candidates: the first boot finished the seeding work and the compositor has nothing to present yet, so the panel shows black
backboardd stopped presenting or the display path lost its scanout buffer
the kernel died after the console was handed to userland, so no panic text appears
decision: the planned power cycle separates these: a second boot that advances past the logo means persistence worked; an identical repeat means the same failure recurs
follow_up_if_repeated: boot with sheng-log=1 so the kernel log persists in the last 32 MiB of userdata, then export it on the host with .cache/archive-logexporter.py
second_boot: owner reports the second boot repeated the same sequence: Apple logo, then a black panel after a while
second_boot_note: persistence did not change the visible outcome, so the next image moves the report to 900 s to record the state at the moment the panel goes dark
